verdict_scope: Terminology and acceptance scope of methods-spec-v1 only; native author calculations, market demand, network repair and launch are separate.

findings.title: 20/18 counts are model endpoint pairs, including MOW; physical airport pairs remain unresolved
findings.mechanism: The grouping key is the unordered from/to strings in undated network_routes. MOW is a metropolitan aggregate, not an operating airport. The table labels len(groups) physical_pair_count and the prose/decision propagates that label. The spec itself distinguishes MOW from ZIA at line49.
findings.reproduction: python3 context/23_night_run_20261110/methods_review/independent_review.py; inspect route_unit_checks.csv: base8 programs/20 model pairs/24 leg rows, cautious8/18/24; contains_MOW_aggregate=True in both.
findings.impact: The present numbers cannot establish the number of physically operated routes or compliance with the case route-count requirement. They still demonstrate that eight author programs and eight rays use different definitions.
findings.minimal_fix: Rename physical_pair_count to model_endpoint_pair_count, replace physical-pair wording in the spec and M05 evidence, retain20/18 unchanged. Add unresolved airport mapping/MOW reason and leave actual physical_airport_pair_count NULL until dated airport resolution.
findings.team_decision_preserved: The case route definition remains OPEN_DECISION. This fix does not select the route definition, reject the eight programs, change author data or calculate a new network.

findings.title: The selected-export checker does not independently verify complete capacity coverage or flight costs
findings.mechanism: The capacity loop checks only rows present in cc, without set equality/uniqueness against physical flights and all used IDs. Flight_variable_cost is taken from comparison.csv; neither a sum of capacity flight costs nor the per-flight cost formula is checked. The checker is scoped export arithmetic, not a general input validator.
findings.reproduction: python3 context/23_night_run_20261110/methods_review/probe_pinned_validator.py runs the exact checker main in memory. Removing a positive occupied UFA capacity row or adding1000000 to the comparison flight cost and subtracting1000000 from its contribution still yields PASS_SCOPED. These are explicit synthetic reader mutations after hash verification, not changes to the pinned source blobs.
findings.impact: The checker alone does not prove these two semantic bridges for arbitrary new exports. No error in the current pinned eight results is demonstrated: the reviewer independently checked complete IDs, per-flight costs, and all eight sums successfully.
findings.minimal_fix: Before using this checker as an admission gate for new exports, assert unique/equal capacity and flight ID sets and independently sum per-leg cost, or explicitly retain the narrower acceptance label. Keep the scoped status and original exports.
findings.team_decision_preserved: No allocation heuristic, tariff, capture law or cost rate is chosen by this test coverage change.

findings.title: The itinerary example retains an obsolete block_method label
findings.mechanism: ARH-UFA in the example has145 minutes and no directional published proxy. RouteModel fallback is30+distance/750*60 rounded up to5 minutes; the inherited metadata says30+distance*1.10/700*60. The code uses virtual dispatch for the number while add_leg constructs metadata from the parent implementation.
findings.reproduction: independent_review.py writes known_metadata_followup.json. A145-minute true fallback constrains distance to(1375,1437.5]km; the inherited formula would yield160..170 minutes, not145. No coordinates or live source are fetched.
findings.impact: The label does not describe the actual numeric method and must not become source support for block time. This was already flagged by comparison_spec.md:74 and requestMR06; it is not a new network repair request or a new numerical cost mismatch.
findings.minimal_fix: In the already assigned network package, preserve the original, emit corrected provenance separately, and map that new exact-SHA metadata into future adapters. Do not change145 solely to fit the stale label.
findings.team_decision_preserved: Published timetable proxy and mathematical fallback remain unverified for RW dispatch; no operational approval is implied.

non_findings.subject: Capture law versus market cap
non_findings.reason: The actual six repeated-pair exports remain below their stated market inputs. Pooled-frequency figures are explicitly AGENT_PROPOSAL_FIXED_SELECTION_NOT_CORRECTED_REPLAY. Missing common budget is a structural contract defect, not proof that87497 is a numerically impossible market outcome or that80581 is uniquely correct.

non_findings.subject: One through fare and physical seat incidence
non_findings.reason: The pinned Tsiri sales, physical legs, capacity and money formulas reconcile in the independent review. The same39.79900399544 journeys consume two seat segments and receive one fare.

non_findings.subject: Donor, own migration and cash/accrual
non_findings.reason: The spec forbids repeated donor deduction, preserves unavoidable obligations, and separates funding from accrual expense. Independent counterexamples confirm these rules; actual donor, cash calendar and full budget remain unknown.
